title: AtpClient
description: AtpClient is an Elixir client library for external automated theorem provers. It provides a uniform interface to multiple backends (SystemOnTPTP, StarExec, Isabelle, and locally installed TPTP-compliant binaries) and reads every system's output into a result carrying its SZS status as a value of the SZS ontology, enabling straightforward cross-prover comparison. It is built on the tptp library, which provides the TPTP language and the SZS ontology.
